about: The Obsidian subfolder rule (T7.4h, T14.29): what the Obsidian page stores for a typed subfolder, or why it refuses it. crates/earshot-runtime (export_settings_tests.rs) runs every case through `export_settings::check_folder` (`stored` is what it returns; `refused` is the refusal's text as the runtime writes it), and packages/ui/src/ipc/vaultFolder.test.ts through the mock's `checkFolder`, whose message is the desktop's sentence of it (first letter upper case, a full stop at the end). A rule or copy change edits both and this table. Every name is invented.
